name: 46616 · South Bend, IN
findings: ZIP 46616 (South Bend) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46616 (South Bend) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
54% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46616 (South Bend) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
